App Name: Luna - AI Companion
Submission ID: 9b27d4e0-1f6a-4c83-b5d9-72e0a4c6f193
Version reviewed: Version 1.3 (42)
Review date: September 17, 2026
Review device: iPad Air (5th generation), iPhone 15

Guideline 1.2 - Safety - User-Generated Content

Issue Description

Your app enables the display of AI-generated content but does not have the required precautions in place. Apps that let users create content with generative AI need all of the following:

- A method for filtering objectionable material from being generated or posted to the app
- A mechanism to report offensive content and timely responses to concerns
- The ability to block abusive users
- Published contact information so users can easily reach you

We were able to generate sexually suggestive images of the AI character by entering a free-text description, even though the outfit options cited in our previous review are no longer shown.

Next Steps

Revise your app to implement all of the precautions above, including filtering prompts and generated images, and resubmit for review. When you resubmit, describe in the App Review notes, with specificity, what changed and how the safeguards work.

Resources

- Review the App Review Guidelines, section 1.2.

Support

- Reply to this message in App Store Connect if you need clarification.
- Request an App Review appointment to discuss this review with a member of the team.
- Ask questions on the Apple Developer Forums.
